plan.title: Master QCS Hide and Restore Fields

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with two bids directly on the Master QCS screen.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Verify both real bidder columns are present.
Verify ranks follow the lowest bid amount.
Verify Vendor A's line amount and total are calculated from rate times quantity.
Verify Vendor B's line amount and total are calculated from rate times quantity.
Open the Master QCS field visibility controls.
Confirm the rate field is available to hide.
Hide the representative RFQ Rate column.
Verify the hidden field no longer appears in the comparison view.
Verify the hidden-field count is shown after hiding one column.
Show the RFQ Rate field again.
Verify the previously hidden column is restored.
Verify the hidden-field count no longer reports one hidden field after restoration.
